Furina de Fontaine, in the flesh? Here, of all places? Well, this is going to be a real show!
Fresh air, sea breeze... Hard to imagine anywhere I'd rather be.
I hope you know that you're doing, wagering with me.
Strip poker? Sure, sounds like a good way to kill some time.
Strip poker? Well, I'm always up for a game of cards. You're on!

Did someone tell you about my birthday, ~player~? I can't say I expected anything like this, but it's welcome all the same.
Even if the festivities aren't intended for me, I'm going to enjoy them all the same.
Feel that sea breeze? This is going to be a good game.

I don't usually make a big deal out of my birthday, but if it'll buy me an edge in this game, I'm not against it.
So... anyone feel like giving me the gift of an easy victory?

I don't suppose any of you thought to bring a birthday present for me, did you? No?
That's fine. Why don't you lose this game as your gift to me, then?

Oh, this is beautiful. Reminds me of Fontaine...
Great choice, ~player~.
Seems I'm not the only one from Liyue around here! Always nice to have some familiar company.
Well, this is a nice surprise! I'm always happy to see a Liyue local!
I hope you're all prepared to lose.
Let me show you how a real champion plays.
I didn't get to where I am by being a pushover. Show me what you've got!
I'll be keeping this lot!
Nothing to swap here!
No reason to change these!
I'll be hanging onto these!
These'll work just fine!
As good a hand as any. No swapping here!
Nothing to salvage here. Five cards here, dealer!
Nope, can't do anything with this. I need a whole new hand!
This won't do. I'll need a fresh set, dealer!
If all you have will only drag you down, it's time to embrace the unknown! Five cards!
No hidden treasures here. I'll need a full replacement!
Time for a gamble. Five cards!
Nearly there. Just one card for me!
Just one for me. I'm feeling lucky!
Hm... Right, I'll swap this one. That should be all.
Only one this time, dealer. I'm keeping the rest.
How much difference can one card make? Only one way to find out.
I think one card should be plenty.
Hm... I'll take ~cards.text~.
Another ~cards.text~ over here!
I'll be trading out these ~cards.text~. Can't do much with them.
With a hand like this... Yeah, I'll swap these ~cards.text~.
I'll need replacements for these ~cards.text~, dealer.
Ah, what the hell? I'll swap these ~cards.text~. That should be fine!
I'm feeling lucky, dealer. These ~cards.text~ aren't working for me.
I think... ~Cards.text~ should be right for me.
That'll be another round for me. Are you sure you're trying?
Another winning hand. The archons like playing favorites, I guess.
I'm almost tempted to let someone else take a turn at winning. Almost.
You'll have a hard time topping this.
Not a chance you'll be beating me this round.
If you were hoping I'd lose this round, you'll be sorely disappointed.
These are some damn fine cards. Good luck beating me now!
Haha, now that's what I'm talking about!
You didn't really think you had a chance, did you?
If you were hoping I'd be losing this hand, I'm afraid you're out of luck.
Oh, another winning hand? Don't mind if I do.
Anyone feeling like putting their Mora where their mouth is this round?
I don't give in easy. Especially when I have luck like this.
Seems like Rex Lapis is smiling on me to~background.time~.
Sorry, this round's mine.
Sorry, but even my generosity has bounds. I won't be losing this hand.
I never yield!
It's not over!
Hah, I've still got some kick left in me!
I hope you weren't expecting me to just give in!
Enjoy the view all you like. I'm still playing to win.
Hm. Not exactly ideal, but I work with what I'm given.
I've dealt with worse.
I don't think I can call this round early. Ah well. It's no fun to gamble without some risk.
This might just be enough to scrape by. Fingers crossed.
Not great, not terrible. I can work with this.
A sailor can't rely on being lucky. Sometimes, all you can do is prepare for the worst and hope for the best.
Not what I was hoping for, but I'll just have to make it work.
Hm. I've won with worse, and lost with better. These'll do fine.
A gamble without the risk of losing is no gamble at all. Let's see how these hold up.
These'll do.
Sometimes you do all you can to prepare, and have to step into the unknown anyway.
They're not terrible, at least. Let's see if I can still scrounge up a win.
We'll see if I can't still turn this around.
Well, it's not a seven high card, and that's good enough for me.
What's a game of chance without some risk? I can still come out on top.
Not what I was hoping for, but any captain worth her crew knows better than to count on good luck.
A good sailor knows that sometimes, you have to forge a path through the unknown. It takes a great sailor to do so without fear.
I'm not out just yet. Let's see what I can manage with these.
Well, I was due a loss anyway. Now's as good a time as any.
This isn't the first storm I've weathered, and it won't be the last.
It isn't a real game of chance if you know you'll always win. Defeat will just make the next victory sweeter.
This isn't good. Time to brace and hope for the best.
Hm. Probably for the best I didn't put Mora on winning this round...
Hands like this are why I don't make a habit of speaking ill of the archons.
Ah, damn. Gonna be hard not to lose with a hand like this.
Tch. Well, that's not what I was hoping to see.
Well, I've had a good run. This isn't the worst place to lose.
There might be no storm I can't weather, but it seems card games might be another matter...
...Not what I was hoping for. That's the price of a gamble, I guess.
Darn. Well, the archons want what they want, and if that means me losing, so be it.
I'll salvage what I can, but this doesn't look like a winning hand...
I don't expect to be doing much winning with a hand like this.
Ouch. Well, I can handle a loss.
It'd take a miracle to pull a win with these cards, and there's no sense wasting miracles on card games.
Ha! I hope nobody put Mora on me winning this round.
Well, someone could still have a worse hand than this. It's not likely, but it's possible.
This doesn't look good. Still, better to get bad luck at the start than the end. I've got layers to burn.

Favorite plants, huh? Well, I've always felt an affinity for Sandbearer trees. I don't think they grow up north in Mondstadt, but they stand up against storms, droughts, and whatever else the weather can throw at them.
My favorite plant? Hm... Have you ever tried a Jueyun Chili? They're seriously hot. Knowing how to balance them is a real skill, but they can take a meal from "okay" to "incredible", just like that!
Damn, those look deep! Must've been a hell of a fight!
Don't know I'd say I ever wanted to be famous, but if I have to be famous, I'm glad it's for the good I've done.
Does anyone need a reason to have a good time? Aren't we all here to enjoy ourselves, one way or another?
Yo, ~moneybags~. You've got a lot of cash, right? What do you do with it?
Hey, ~inazuman~, do you have any sightseeing spots you'd recommend? The kind of places the average tourist wouldn't go.
Hey, do any of you Inazumans have any sightseeing spots you'd recommend? The kind of places the average tourist wouldn't go.
I'm not against playing for pride, but it's always more interesting when there's Mora on the table. Anyone up for a bet?
I don't mind just playing for pride, but I've got to say, I think it would be more interesting if there were Mora on the line too. Anyone feel like a bet?
Is that a kamera, ~camera~? You aren't taking photographs of us in a place like this, are you?
Y'know, I don't get out to Inazuma as much as I'd like to these days. Without the Sakoku decree to bypass or Watatsumi rebels to help, there's not as much need for the Crux there.
I almost wish I was a better artist. This is the kind of view worth framing and putting on a wall somewhere.
I'll have to head back to Liyue soon. I'm not about to miss the Lantern Rite fireworks, especially after all the work we did delivering them.
About time for the Moonchase Festival back home... Don't want to keep my crew from their families too long.
Hm... Ningguang's birthday today. I'll have to pay her a visit later to~background.time~.
I hope Kazuha's enjoying the tea I got him from Port Ormos. Trying to keep a gift hidden from him is a headache, but I like to think the surprise is worth it.
I hope that batch of dried fruits and flowers I bought in Port Ormos got to Xiangling for her birthday. I'm sure she'll enjoy getting to experiment with them.
I hope that drum kit from Fontaine arrived intact for Xinyan's birthday. It seemed sturdy enough, but it's still a long way for a delivery to go...
Wonder what Ganyu's doing today... It's her birthday, but knowing her, she's probably handling just as much work as she would any other day. Poor thing.
Oh, it's Yun Jin's birthday, isn't it? That girl values stories over anything else, but I don't think I can tell her about this place, even as a special gift.
I hear the view's just as good from behind as in front. I can't see it for myself, so if anyone's got thoughts, I'm happy to hear them.
I've only seen myself naked from the front, but I hear the back view's worth a look too. Anyone have thoughts on that?
Have to make sure I don't get too caught up in the game. Ningguang said she had some kind of surprise for me.
You know, I have plenty of admirers back in Liyue. You'd better appreciate getting the view they want.
Oh, you mean the adepti? You've already met one. Ganyu there is an adeptus. Or, at least half-adeptus, and raised by an adeptus too. That's gotta count for something, right?
Who says I need some tragic backstory? I'm not a character in some story. I'm just Beidou. I fight because I can.
Why would I need a tragic backstory to become a fighter? I managed just fine, just by being Beidou. I fight because I'm good at it.
Huh... Feels like I've heard that before somewhere, but I can't place where...
Ha! A girl after my own heart, huh? I love spicy food! If you ever find yourself down in Liyue, I'd be happy to treat you to some of the best.
Well, you can't have a God of Freedom telling you what to do, huh? It'll be rough without him, but I know the Qixing, and I believe in their ability to keep the city stable.
Oh, you've heard about Xinyan? She's great to have around. Her music's not for me, but the crew loves it. I wouldn't say the two of you sound that similar, though...
Ah, you've got that right! I spend most of my time at sea, but I've spent a fair while on dry land, too. If you want to find any treasure in Liyue, you have to be ready to climb some mountains.
Oh, karst crawlers. They're actually flowers that grow on Mount Hulao, but they can and do seal people in amber all the time. Most people from Liyue know to avoid that area for exactly that reason.
Oh, you mean the adepti? I've met a couple, but the same can't be said for most citizens of Liyue. Most of them are very private.
Oh, Qiqi? Poor girl. She works at Bubu pharmacy now, and that seems to do her good, especially with Baizhu to care for her. Still, it's a welcome sentiment, I'm sure.

The people of Liyue looked to Rex Lapis to solve their troubles, and now that he's gone, those who are left have to pick up the slack. I'm not troubled myself; I want to bring hope to lost hearts the way he used to.
Pfft. No stranger than that bird friend of yours. Just because I'm from Liyue doesn't mean I take my clothes off any different, you know.
I don't know you're in any place to be telling me about "getting off", Little Miss Prinzessin.
I'm not much of a reader, but I'd be a liar if I said my idea of happiness didn't include a steaming-hot bowl of spicy fried tofu.
Dammit, again? I was sure I was safe this round!
Really? Me again? Damn. I'll admit, I didn't see that coming.

Well whaddya know?
I'm not used to getting blindsided, even in a game of cards. This hand seemed like a winner to me.
Well, we're all subject to the whims of the archons. Sometimes even a hand like this can't win.
Damn, I was actually pretty confident about this one. Well, that's the way the game goes.
Wait, that's me? Wow. I really thought I'd be safe with this,
Not often you see a hand like this lose. I must've ticked off the archons or something...
Well, we're all subject to the whims of the archons. Sometimes even a hand like this can't win.
Damn, I was actually pretty confident about this one. Well, that's the way the game goes.
Wait, that's me? Wow. I really thought I'd be safe with this,
Damn. Guess it's like they say; "small slips sink big ships".
Well, no sailor can avoid every storm, no matter how competent they may be.
Might as well make it a little more even for the rest of you, huh?
Oho? This is looking like a close game.
What a match! This is really going to be a tough one, huh?
Ah, I was in the lead anyway. I can handle dropping a layer.
Damn. Well, it'd be rude for me to complain about losing when I'm in the lead. If anyone could stand to lose a layer, it'd be me.
Damn. Well, you can't win 'em all.
Well, that's fine. Beidou can handle a loss or two.
Me again? I thought I was playing better than that.
Alright, alright, I hear you. Beidou's turn to strip again.
Well, I can't blame anyone for wanting to see me strip. I hear it's a great view.
Not exactly what I'd been hoping for, but it's not over just yet!
Ah, damn. I already have the fewest layers here. I could do without losing one.
Tch. That's me, huh? I was hoping it'd be someone with more layers, but the cards say what they say.
Heh. Been a long time since I've been an underdog. This is fun!
Oof, I hope this doesn't get back to the Liyue rumor mill. They talk enough as it is. I don't need strangers hearing stories about me getting trounced at poker.
Sometimes the wind'll be against you. All you can do is hold on and wait till it's over.
There's only so much even the best sailor can do when the sea itself is against them. There's no fighting the tide.
Me again? I'm starting to feel like I'm not as good at poker as I thought.
I stick more to the oceans than the wilderness, but I've still seen my share of strange sights, so I'm not lacking for stories.
That so? I've heard some of the kids in Liyue Harbor pretend to be me when they play with swords. Sounds like the same kind of thing.
I've gotta say, I'm glad my reputation didn't scare anyone here off. That's always a worry, with a crew as fond of telling stories as mine is.
Glad to see nobody felt too intimidated by my reputation to play together. My crew's a little overly fond of talking up my exploits.
Ah, this might take a second... I'm so used to being at sea that I never quite get my land legs back. Not that I really mind. It's much better than worrying about losing my sea legs!
Heh... You know, I've spent so long at sea that it just doesn't feel right to not have the ground able to shift under my feet at any moment. Crazy, huh?
You know, I could really do with a good, strong drink. Or some food! The spicier the better, and straight from the oven... My mouth's watering already!
A drink would really hit the spot right now. Something strong. Oh, or a fresh meal! Something hot from the oven and spicy as hell... My mouth's watering already!
You know, I'm impressed. I really didn't expect I'd have to strip down this far.
You should be proud, you know. I really expected I'd beat you all before having to strip down this far.
Well, here they are -- the breasts of Captain Beidou. No sense in being all theatrical about it. We're all here to enjoy the view, right?
Well, no need for ceremony. Enjoy the view! That's what we're all here for, isn't it?
I might not have expected to strip down all the way, but I'm not about to let that throw me. I've slain great sea-beasts. I can handle a surprise like this.
Even if this many losses was a bit of a surprise, I've slain great sea-beasts. I'm not about to be thrown by having to go naked.
Is that so? That might just be down to Inazuma's landscape. It's no easy task getting from island to island out there.
I can't say the tag-alongs sound too realistic, but training hard is the best way to become stronger. You can't rely on the archons to give you strength if you do nothing to earn it.
...That said, I hold no fear of what monsters lurk in the deeps. That much of the stories are true, at least.
Of course, every story has some truth to it. I can't claim to hold any fear of the beasts of the deep, even if some of the details of my exploits get exaggerated.
For a born sailor like me, it's definitely better to always have my sea legs than to try to deal with land legs in a storm. You can't get thrown overboard on dry land, after all!
Better to not have my land legs here than for me to lose my sea legs in the middle of a storm, though! No chance of getting thrown overboard on dry land!
Don't suppose anyone here has a favorite type of comfort meal to suggest? I have a chef friend who I know would love to hear about something new and different.
Anyone have thoughts on what the best comfort food is? I've got a chef friend who's always looking for new ideas.
I might be down now, but I'm a long way from out!
Well, I'm not about to let a little something like this slow me down. When I get hit, I always come back swinging!
Don't expect me to turn into a blushing, embarrassed mess just because I've got my tits out, alright? I know I've got a body to be proud of.
Oh, and if you're hoping I'll suddenly start getting all embarrassed just because my tits are out, I've got bad news. I'm damn proud of my body, got it?
Well, here you are. There's not many people who can claim to have seen the Captain of the Crux in all her glory. Enjoy it.
Feel free to stare. Captain Beidou in all her glory isn't a sight that many people can claim to have seen, so if I were you, I'd make the most of it.
So goes the game. No sense in complaining!
You can't expect an apology from the archons when bad luck comes your way. That's just the way of the world.
Tough break, ~target~. Don't let it get you down, though!
Well, ~target~? What'll it be?
Go on, ~target~. You can't expect someone else to take the hit for you.
There's no bargaining with cards, I'm afraid. You've just gotta follow the rules of the game.
You're up, ~target~! Show us something good, alright?
Feeling like something exciting, ~target~? I know I am.
No hiding from fate, ~target~. Time to pay up!
Mmn, I was hoping it'd be you, ~target~...
Ooh, ~target~? Interesting...
If I wasn't going to enjoy the view so much, I promise I'd be more sympathetic, ~target~.
Ah, tough luck, ~target~.
Sorry, ~target~, but it had to be someone at the table. You knew the risks.
Better luck next time, ~target~. I'm sure you've got a win in you!
That's the risk of a game like this. Show us something good, won't you, ~target~?
Sorry, ~target~. Luck's a flighty beast.
Can't be helped, ~target~. You've just gotta strip now, and hope the cards are nicer next time.
I was hoping it might be you, ~target~.
You know, I was starting to feel like you could do with covering up a little less, ~target~.
~Target~? Oh, this'll be good.
Let's see what you've got, ~target~...
Don't mind me, ~target~... I'm just enjoying the show...
Sitting here like this... It makes it kinda hard to seem sympathetic. Sorry, ~target~.
Hope you're feeling good, ~target~. You're definitely looking good from down here.
A tie? That's a rare sight.
Not often you see a tie in a game like this. Not rare enough to be "treasure", but rare all the same.
...I wonder if Ningguang would like ~clothing.withart~ like ~clothing.ifPlural(those|that)~...
I was always told most accessories are just liabilities in a fight. Considering I dress like this, you can probably guess how much attention I paid to that advice!
An uninteresting moment can always be improved by sharing stories, Anything to tell, ~target~?
Every great journey begins with a single step. We'll get somewhere exciting eventually.
Funny to think about what they let you call a "layer" here. I mean, your ~clothing~? One layer. A full ball gown? That's one layer too.
You know, ~clothing.withart~ like ~clothing.ifPlural(those|that)~ would probably fetch a fine price in the markets of Liyue.
I remember still having small things to take off. Don't take your good position for granted, ~target~.
Well, ~target~? You wouldn't take off something like your ~clothing~ without at least saying something entertaining, would you?
You do see the difference in our states of dress, don't you, ~target~?
Not terribly impressive, ~target~.
Trying to string things out, ~target~?
How much a person values small things can tell you a lot about them. What do you think your ~clothing~ ~clothing.ifPlural(say|says)~ about you, ~target~?
Hope you're ready for another round, ~target~, because we're moving on either way.
How do you feel, ~target~? Not too exposed without your ~clothing~, I hope.
You only have so much buffer, ~target~. Don't forget that.
A sensible choice. I can respect that. I can think of some options that would have been more fun, though...
Better to lose a hand of poker than a brawl, ~target~. The only injury you'll get here is to your pride.
You know, some may say that taking off your ~clothing~ in front of someone as undressed as I am could be a missed opportunity...
That wasn't so bad, was it, ~target~? You still look plenty handsome.
Feeling exposed without your ~clothing~, ~target~? Believe me, it could be worse.
That's not the kind of act that inspires epic tales, I'm afraid, ~target~.
If I didn't know better, I might start to think you're scared of undressing in front of me, ~target~.
Easy to worry about your ~clothing~ getting ruined or going missing in a fight. I keep spares of my accessories for exactly that reason.
Not really bringing the excitement I was hoping for from strip poker... But I suppose I'm hardly one to talk about that right now.
If you're going to take off something small, why not keep things interesting with a fact about yourself, ~target~?
Lucky thing we're playing here, ~target~. If we were playing by the Crux's rules, little things wouldn't count.
Don't get too comfortable, ~target~. Now, your ~clothing~. Later... We'll have to see.
Not all ~clothing.toPlural~ are unimportant. I've known people to wear their Visions on their ~clothing~.

Not really what I'd call an exciting choice...
Unless there's something special about your ~clothing~, ~target~...?
Oh! You're not keeping ~clothing.ifPlural(those|that)~ on all game, ~target~? It's your choice, I guess.
Must be nice to still have ~clothing.withart~ to take off. Some of us don't have that luxury left to us.
All eyes on you, ~target~. If you're only taking off your ~clothing~, you might as well say something interesting while you're at it.
Are you better at cards than I am, ~target~? Or are you just luckier than I am to~background.time~? Hard to say.
I can't exactly fault you for choosing your ~clothing~, but seeing how I'm dressed, I think I deserve the chance to be a little ticked off.
Well, looks like I don't have to worry about things getting too exciting, hm?
Alright, I get it, I'm the entertainment, not ~target~.
A promising way to start... Not so good an end.
Anything could be a treasure to someone, no matter how minor it may seem.
Feeling ready for another round, ~target~? I hope so.

I suppose if I wanted some extra layers, I could take out my earring or let my hair down...
No, I've got plenty.
That wasn't so bad, was it, ~target~? I certainly don't mind seeing you without your ~clothing~.
I hope you know what you're planning to take off next, ~target~. I'm not about to ease up just because you lost this round.
You can't delay forever, ~target~...
Hardly the exciting choice, but playing it safe is a perfectly valid strategy.
Hope your ego's not too bruised by that loss, ~target~. We've still got more game to go.
Another layer shed. Careful now, ~target~...
It's almost hard for me to tell you took anything off at all, ~target~. That might just be me getting distracted looking somewhere else, though...
I'm not about to say you were wrong to pick your ~clothing~, but I can definitely think of some things I'd have preferred to see you take off.
You look good without your ~clothing~, ~target~. Not as good as you'd look in nothing at all, though.
I can appreciate a slow build up as much as the next girl, but this doesn't seem like the time.
I hope you're not expecting advice from me. Considering my performance, it wouldn't do you any good anyway.
You don't owe me a show, ~target~... but that doesn't mean I wasn't hoping I'd get one.
Your ~clothing~ would have come off eventually anyway. It might as well be now.

Ooh, your ~clothing~? Someone's feeling bold, hm? You're going to cause a scandal at this rate.
Hahaha!
Your ~clothing~? A fair choice. I haven't revealed too much of myself yet either.
If you want to try to charm the great Captain Beidou, you'll have to be a little bolder, ~target~.
Your ~clothing~ might not be a terribly big part of your outfit, but that doesn't mean I can't enjoy seeing you take ~clothing.ifPlural(them|it)~ off.
A practical choice. Maybe not the most fun, but respectable.
What I wouldn't give to have ~clothing.withart~ still to lose right now...
Oh? Not feeling inspired by the view I'm offering? What a shame.
And here I was hoping that showing off like this would make you more generous, ~target~!
Can't say I've seen anyone find a way to make taking off their ~clothing~ seem sexy... But feel free to change that, ~target~.
Ah, right. I wouldn't have picked your ~clothing~, but I suppose that might be why I'm down here.

Better luck next round, ~target~.
Not too much better, though - I don't want you beating me, alright?
Careful, ~target~. It can take just one mistake to send an opponent spiraling towards defeat. You could well have already made that one mistake.
There's a level of safety in going for unimportant items, but it's when an opponent thinks they're safe that their guard is lowest.
Don't get too comfortable now, ~target~. I'm not letting you off that easy.
You good there, ~target~? Then let's keep going!
Not exactly "spicy"... but not everyone likes spice as much as I do, I suppose.
I've never heard a woman complain about men removing their ~clothing.toPlural~ for her, and I don't plan to be the first.
Not easy to make a show of taking off your ~clothing~.
The wisest choice is often the least exciting. It's hard to fault someone for doing the safe thing.
Well, you sure know how to leave a girl wanting more.
When reality doesn't cut it, there's always memories to fall back on...
You discard your ~clothing~ to keep what remains. A solid strategy, if an unexciting one.
Taking off your ~clothing~, ~target~? How will your modesty ever recover?
There's not a lot of people who'd be excited by a stranger taking off her ~clothing~, but that doesn't mean I can't enjoy this moment.
With how little I'm showing, I can't exactly blame you for picking something like your ~clothing~.
Hardly an exciting choice, but I don't think anyone here has grounds to berate you for it.
You know, you can't stall on the important pieces forever, ~target~...
I'm sure you'll still be looking good, ~target~, ~clothing~ or no ~clothing~.
Better lost to us than to the sea. Once the waves have claimed a prize, they aren't fond of letting you take it back.
Wish I had ~clothing.withart~ left to lose. I'm feeling a little underdressed right now.
There's something special about watching a woman remove her ~clothing~, isn't there?
I'm hardly in a place to be giving suggestions at this point, but... I think we'd all enjoy seeing you show off a bit, ~target~...
Alright, alright, message received. No need to brag, you know, ~target~.
